decisions.reason: As a newly launched dietary-supplement range with its own page, close fit to the stated portfolio-broadening strategy, and visible commercial commitment, management is likely to continue it rather than admit an early mistake.

This skin-and-hair supplement was publicly launched and given its own page, so the firm has made a visible commitment and will likely persist while attributing any early weakness to normal market build-up.

The joint-health supplement is less prominently backed than A or B, but it still extends the existing consumer-health offer and an expanding firm using escalation-of-commitment logic would usually give it more time.

Because this immune supplement appears more niche and was only mentioned briefly, it has a somewhat higher drop risk, but its recent launch and fit with consumer-health expansion still make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

Although this generic blood-pressure product is more distant from the established offer and faced a visible problem notice, the regulatory and launch investment is substantial and management can treat the setback as temporary, so it is still slightly more likely to be retained.
